purpose: Web app where DeMolay-RO chapter officers submit state campaign activities and reviewers grade them.

agent_rules.R01: DO NOT write from scratch what a maintained free library already does. Name the library before coding.
agent_rules.R02: Follow official Supabase docs for Auth, RLS, Storage, Edge Functions. No custom auth, no custom crypto, no custom session handling.
agent_rules.R03: Free tiers only. No dependency requiring a credit card or paid plan.
agent_rules.R04: One table or one screen per change. Small diffs. Run build + lint + tests before declaring done.
agent_rules.R05: Never install a package without stating name and reason. Prefer packages with recent releases and high usage.
agent_rules.R06: Authorization lives in the database (RLS), never only in the UI.
agent_rules.R07: No secrets in code or in git. Only VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY reach the client.
agent_rules.R08: Validate every input with zod on client and on server (Edge Function / DB constraints).
agent_rules.R09: Never log personal data. Never put personal data in URLs.
agent_rules.R10: Email + password auth only. No OAuth providers.

email.auth_emails: custom SMTP configured in Supabase Auth (free provider: Brevo or Resend)
email.app_emails: Edge Function calling provider HTTP API with official SDK or fetch
email.note: Built-in Supabase mailer is rate-limited; do not rely on it.

roles.member: chapter officer; submits activities for own chapter; requires status=approved
roles.reviewer: grades submissions of all chapters; cannot manage users
roles.admin: reviewer + approve/reject users + manage campaigns, activities, chapters

profiles: id uuid pk fk auth.users on delete cascade
attachments: submission_id uuid fk on delete cascade
comments: submission_id uuid fk on delete cascade

db_helpers.is_approved(): security definer; true if auth.uid() has profiles.status='approved'
db_helpers.current_role(): security definer; returns profiles.role for auth.uid()
db_helpers.current_chapter(): security definer; returns profiles.chapter_id for auth.uid()
db_helpers.trigger_on_signup: after insert on auth.users -> insert profiles(status='pending', role='member')
db_helpers.trigger_protect_profile: before update on profiles: if actor is not admin, block changes to role, status, chapter_id
db_helpers.trigger_audit: after insert/update/delete on submissions(score,status), profiles(role,status) -> audit_log
db_helpers.set_search_path: all security definer functions must set search_path = public

rls.global: ENABLE and FORCE RLS on every table in public. Default deny. Never create 'using (true)' policies for authenticated.

profiles.update: admin only (members may update only full_name, via trigger guard)
profiles.insert: none from client (created by signup trigger)

submissions.select: is_approved() AND (chapter_id = current_chapter() OR current_role() in ('reviewer','admin'))
submissions.insert: is_approved() AND chapter_id = current_chapter() AND submitted_by = auth.uid() AND status in ('draft','submitted')
submissions.update_member: is_approved() AND chapter_id = current_chapter() AND status in ('draft','returned') AND score is not changed
submissions.update_reviewer: current_role() in ('reviewer','admin'); may set status in ('returned','approved'), score, reviewed_by, reviewed_at
submissions.delete: member only own draft; admin any

attachments.insert: only on own chapter's submission with status in ('draft','returned')

comments.insert: any user who can see the submission; author_id = auth.uid()

storage.policies: mirror attachments table policies; members only inside own chapter_id prefix; reviewers/admins read all
storage.access: signed URLs only, expiry <= 300s, generated on demand
storage.client_checks: mime + size before upload; rename file to uuid; never trust filename

auth_flow: S1 signup(email, password, full_name, chapter_id, position, terms_accepted=true) via supabase.auth.signUp; email confirmation REQUIRED
S2 trigger creates profiles row status=pending
S3 pending user can sign in but router shows only /awaiting-approval; DB denies all data via is_approved()
S4 Edge Function notify_new_signup (DB webhook on profiles insert) emails all reviewers/admins
S5 admin approves/rejects in /admin/users; update writes status + audit_log
S6 Edge Function notify_user_decision (DB webhook on profiles.status update) emails the user: approved or rejected
S7 on approval user gets full access on next session refresh

auth_rules.leaked_password_protection: enable in Supabase Auth settings if available
auth_rules.signup_captcha: Cloudflare Turnstile or hCaptcha on signup and login
auth_rules.email_domain_policy: chapter email as provided; optional allowlist table (allowed_emails) checked in signup trigger, reject if not listed
auth_rules.session: supabase-js default; no tokens in localStorage manually; sign out on role change

routes.guards: RouteGuard component checks session, status=approved, role; UI guard is convenience only (R06)

member: list open campaigns and activities with due date and points
submit activity: description + up to 5 attachments
reviewer: table of submissions with filters: chapter, campaign, activity, status
review screen: preview attachment via signed URL, set score <= activity.points, approve or return with comment

security_requirements.S01: RLS enabled and forced on all tables; verified by tests as each role.
security_requirements.S02: service_role key only inside Edge Functions secrets; never in client, repo or logs.
security_requirements.S03: Privilege escalation blocked: members cannot change own role/status/chapter (trigger + policy).
security_requirements.S04: Reviewer score validated server-side: 0 <= score <= activities.points.
security_requirements.S05: Private storage bucket + signed URLs short-lived + mime/size enforced.
security_requirements.S06: All forms validated with zod; DB constraints mirror limits.
security_requirements.S07: Render user text as plain text. If HTML is ever needed, sanitize with DOMPurify. No dangerouslySetInnerHTML with raw input.
security_requirements.S08: Security headers set in the static host config: Content-Security-Policy (self + Supabase origin + captcha origin), X-Content-Type-Options nosniff, Referrer-Policy strict-origin-when-cross-origin, frame-ancestors 'none'.
security_requirements.S09: CAPTCHA on signup/login; rely on Supabase Auth rate limits; generic error messages (no user enumeration).
security_requirements.S10: Edge Functions: verify JWT, verify caller role, validate payload, verify webhook secret, no open email relay (recipient list built server-side, never from request body).
security_requirements.S11: audit_log for approvals, role changes, score changes.
security_requirements.S12: Minimal admins (<= 3); document 2FA requirement for admins on GitHub, Supabase, email accounts.
security_requirements.S13: Dependencies: lockfile committed; run npm audit; enable Dependabot; no abandoned packages.
security_requirements.S14: Backup routine: scheduled export script (pg_dump or CSV via Supabase) stored outside Supabase; document restore steps.
security_requirements.S15: Fail closed: on any authorization doubt, deny.

lgpd_requirements.L01: Data minimization: only full_name, chapter email, chapter, position, submission content. No CPF, address, phone.
lgpd_requirements.L02: Privacy policy and terms pages; signup requires explicit acceptance; store terms_accepted_at.
lgpd_requirements.L03: Many users may be under 18: show guardian-consent notice; store guardian_consent_at when required by the Order's process; apply best-interest principle (LGPD art. 14).
lgpd_requirements.L04: Attachments guidance in UI: avoid identifiable faces of minors unless authorized.
lgpd_requirements.L05: Data subject rights: contact email on /privacy; admin function to export and delete a user's data (cascade delete profile, submissions, attachments, storage objects).
lgpd_requirements.L06: Retention: configurable job/script to delete submissions and attachments N months after campaign end.
lgpd_requirements.L07: Access restricted by role; personal data visible only to reviewers/admins and the owner chapter.
lgpd_requirements.L08: Incident plan documented in docs/INCIDENT.md: rotate keys, revoke sessions, notify affected users and the Order.
lgpd_requirements.L09: No analytics/trackers or third-party scripts that collect personal data.

tests_required: member of chapter A cannot select submissions of chapter B
pending user cannot select any data table
rejected user cannot select any data table
member cannot update own role, status or chapter_id
member cannot set score or approve own submission
reviewer cannot change user role or status
reviewer score above activity.points is rejected
upload with disallowed mime or size > 5 MB is rejected
storage object of chapter B not readable by member of chapter A
unauthenticated request returns nothing on every table
signup creates profile with status=pending and role=member regardless of client payload
Edge Functions reject calls without valid JWT or webhook secret
definition_of_done: tsc, eslint, build and tests pass
README lists env vars and setup of Supabase, SMTP and webhooks
S01-S15 and L01-L09 each mapped to implemented code or documented gap
build_order: B1 supabase schema + enums + helpers + triggers
B2 RLS policies + storage policies + tests_required (DB level)
B3 auth screens + approval gate + awaiting-approval
B5 campaigns/activities read for members + admin CRUD
B7 reviewer table + review screen + ranking + CSV
B8 Edge Functions for emails + webhooks
B10 security headers config + audit + backup script
